lines.text: Unlocks: Clear event stage 101610107 · After Anis chat 4. Commander!

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Hey, Pit Boss,

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: did you get back safe?

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: We wanted to escort you to Commander's Room,

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: but it turned out you had to walk us back to the dormitory. Thanks.
You're welcome.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: We were supposed to give you good luck,

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: but I guess it was the other way around, lol

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: Tomorrow is the big day. Are you tired?

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: I didn't realize it was so late :p
It's okay, I've got plenty of energy.

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: Haha!

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: :D

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Thanks for all your help.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Sorry to have bothered you.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: How can we ever repay you?

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: Don't stress too much about the competition.

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: Even if you don't win, it's okay.

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: We're just grateful that you're willing to show up for us.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Yeah, super grateful!

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I doubt we'll have a lot of time to interact with you tomorrow,

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: but just remember that we're cheering for you.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Yeah, we'll be thinking about you!

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: We certainly will, the whole day!
Thanks, everyone.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Sleep well.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: See you tomorrow.
Don't forget to dream about me.
Good night, and good luck.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Lol, sure thing!

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: See you in our dreams.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Wow, you sound like a radio presenter.

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: Can't wait to see the face behind that voice, hehe!

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Blanc, Noir.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: We have to get up earlier tomorrow.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Go to bed.

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: You got it.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: See you all tomorrow!!!
